meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: Claude 会像装机医生一样检查你的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装：对照最新源码逐项体检，输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告，每条结论都附上对应的命令输出或文件证据。它只做诊断，不擅自改你的配置。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到「LazyCodex」等名称，或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常、怀疑安装过期或损坏时，它会接管。

say.text: 帮我给 LazyCodex 做一次 doctor 检查
say.note: 先同步最新源码，再逐项体检

say.text: 我升级 Codex 后行为不对，帮我看看
say.note: 会对比最新源码找出差异

say.text: 检查我的 LazyCodex 配置和插件接线有没有漂移
say.note: 最后给出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告与修复建议

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an install doctor for LazyCodex and Codex CLI: it inspects the local setup, compares it to the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report, each verdict citing its evidence. It only diagnoses, never changes.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex by name, or Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run a doctor check on my LazyCodex install
say_en.note: Syncs latest sources first, then checks

say_en.text: Codex acts odd after I updated it, please diagnose
say_en.note: Compares against latest sources for drift

say_en.text: Audit my config and plugin wiring for drift
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with fixes
